findings.claim: كُفْرِ, söylenen iman iddiasını gerçeği örten ve reddeden bir durum imgesiyle karşılar.
findings.mechanism: Kökün örtme alanı, ءَامَنَّا sözünün hemen ardından ve girişe eşlik eden بِٱلْكُفْرِ içinde belirir; böylece dışarıdaki kabul sözü ile içeride taşınan örtme aynı cümlede çarpışır.
findings.reader_payoff: Okur, küfrü yalnız soyut bir etiket değil, iddia edilen imanın üzerini örten bir karşı-hareket gibi algılar.
findings.containment: Örtme imgesi dinî reddin yerel anlamını derinleştirir; fiziksel örtü veya nimet yadsıması ayrıca etkinleştirilmez.

epistemic.reason: Paketteki güvenilir yüzey ve analiz desteği ilişkiyi doğrudan kuruyor.

findings.title: Eşik boyunca taşınan kamusal güvence
findings.claim: Atfedilmiş iz, ayeti bir eşik karşılaşması olarak da kurar: işitilen iman sözü kamusal bir güvence gibi görünürken örtülü küfür giriş ve çıkışta değişmeden taşınır.
findings.mechanism: Before: grup iman ettiğini söylerken küfürle kalır. After: yaklaşma sosyal bir eşik açar, sözlü iman iddiası kamusal arayüz olur, giriş ve çıkış aynı iç durumu taşır, gizleme ise bu sürekliliği görünür olmaktan alıkoyar.
findings.reader_payoff: Okur, ayetin söz, yaklaşma ve iki yönlü geçişi tek bir karşılaşma eşiğinde nasıl birleştirdiğini görür.
findings.containment: Bu, exact focus trace'e dayanan legacy_unbound bir atfedilmiş okumadır; root_000281/B001 için doğrulanmış sözlük dalı veya facet ileri sürülmez ve olağan ayet anlamı korunur.

epistemic.reason: HFT kaydının anchor kapsamı tam ve focus koordinatları uyumlu olsa da reader identity legacy_unbound olduğu için ilişki qualified ve attributed tutuluyor.

branch_activations.carrier: The attributed trace assigns the coming form the role of approach into a bounded encounter.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The spoken claim and the paired entry-exit movement supply the social threshold around that approach.
branch_activations.activation: The coming carrier meets the public speech and paired transit, so arrival is heard as approach to a guarded social threshold.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The approach opens the bounded encounter in which an audible faith credential is presented.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch registry supplies no independent gloss or facet for this root; ordinary directed arrival remains recoverable.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek işlem, sözü sesli olarak dışa çıkarmaktır.
branch_activations.carrier: The articulated saying form carries speech brought into public sound.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The directed arrival and the first-person belief quotation give that speech a public credential role.
branch_activations.activation: Public saying meets a directed visit and an asserted belief, making the utterance available as the encounter's audible credential.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The spoken profession functions as a public-facing credential at the social threshold.
branch_activations.boundary: The ordinary report of speech remains primary; no sincerity is inferred from the utterance itself.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel cekirdek bir haberin, sozun veya hakikatin dogru sayilmasidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The belief form carries asserted assent and acceptance.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The speech verb presents it publicly while the following kufr phrase supplies the contrary carried state.
branch_activations.activation: Asserted assent meets public articulation and the named contrary state, so the profession becomes the credential's claimed content rather than proof of inner change.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The audible credential claims acceptance while concealed kufr remains the carried state.
branch_activations.boundary: The registered core is acceptance of a report or truth; the trace does not establish that this acceptance is genuine here.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kişi ya da şey dışarıdaki bir konum veya durumdan içerideki konum veya duruma geçer.
branch_activations.carrier: The entry verb carries literal ingress across the encounter boundary.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The directed approach and the later exit supply the two sides of the bounded visit.
branch_activations.activation: Literal ingress meets the approach and its mirrored egress, making entry the first side of a social threshold crossed with a carried state.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The encounter contains a first threshold crossing in which the inner state is already present.
branch_activations.boundary: The Form I entry remains literal; no separate covert-entry gloss is claimed.

branch_activations.facet_statement: İnancın karşıtı olarak dinî gerçeği, birliği, dinî hükmü veya peygamberliği reddetme.
branch_activations.carrier: The kufr noun carries rejection of religious truth as the state at ingress.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The asserted belief and completed entry place this rejection beneath the public credential and inside the threshold.
branch_activations.activation: Religious rejection meets the belief claim and entry carrier, so kufr becomes the hidden state carried through the encounter.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The concealed state under the audible credential is religious rejection carried at entry.
branch_activations.boundary: The registered branch concerns religious truth and belief; other covering or gratitude facets are not asserted.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: bir yerden ya da durumdan dışarı çıkma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir yerden, kapsayıcıdan veya durumdan dışarıya geçme hareketi gerçekleşir.
branch_activations.carrier: The exit verb carries passage to the outside as the second threshold crossing.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The literal entry and the explicitly reset group before exit provide the first boundary and unchanged actors.
branch_activations.activation: Passage outward meets the prior ingress and the re-identified group, completing the threshold pair without changing the carried state.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The visit ends with the same group and concealed state crossing outward.
branch_activations.boundary: The registered core is ordinary outward passage; no expulsion or specialized exit facet is added.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel işlem, bir şeyin veya bilginin açıklanmasını engelleyerek onu gizli tutmaktır.
branch_activations.carrier: The concealment verb carries deliberate withholding from disclosure.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The public saying and the paired entry-exit movement provide the interface whose inner continuity remains hidden.
branch_activations.activation: Withholding meets the public credential and both threshold crossings, so the concealed state can pass through the encounter without being disclosed.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The public interface and the carried inner state remain unequal because deliberate concealment keeps the latter from view.
branch_activations.boundary: The registered core is withholding information or content; no physical seal or silence-only facet is claimed.

findings.title: Kamusal söz ile gizli kayıt
findings.claim: Atfedilmiş ikinci iz, ayette iki bilgi kaydı kurar: insanlar söylenen ve görünen geçişi duyar; Allah ise zaman içinde saklanan içeriği bilir.
findings.mechanism: Before: sonuç yalnızca onların sözünün yanlışlığı olarak görünür. After: قَالُوا۟ kamusal olarak işitilen kaydı, يَكْتُمُونَ ile كَانُوا۟ ise süren ve saklanan ikinci kaydı kurar; أَعْلَمُ بِمَا bu ikinci kaydı ilahi bilginin alanına alır.
findings.reader_payoff: Okur, ayetteki gerilimi yalnız doğru-yanlış söz karşıtlığı değil, kamusal erişim ile saklı içerik arasındaki eşitsizlik olarak da algılar.
findings.containment: Bu, exact focus trace'e dayanan legacy_unbound bir atfedilmiş okumadır; içteki kayıt bağımsız bir yeni alıntı sayılmaz ve ayetin açık söz/fiil anlamı korunur.

epistemic.reason: HFT kaydının anchor kapsamı tam ve focus koordinatları uyumlu olsa da reader identity legacy_unbound olduğu için ilişki qualified ve attributed tutuluyor.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek işlem, sözü sesli olarak dışa çıkarmaktır.
branch_activations.carrier: The articulated saying form carries the register accessible to the visitors' human audience.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The direct belief quotation supplies the emitted content, while the concealment clause supplies what remains outside that public register.
branch_activations.activation: Articulated saying meets the belief claim and hidden content, defining the public register by what can be heard.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: People receive an emitted belief claim as the accessible register of the encounter.
branch_activations.boundary: The trace concerns the public register of speech; it does not turn the utterance into proof of inner belief.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek anlam, sözün içte tasarlanmış fakat açığa vurulmamış olmasıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: The same saying carrier can bear a word remaining within the self before public disclosure.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The hidden-content clause and the divine knowledge predicate provide an independent concealed register behind the articulated claim.
branch_activations.activation: The articulated form meets concealment and superior knowing, so the saying acquires a contrasting unvoiced counterpart held behind the public claim.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The ayah presents a public utterance alongside a second register of withheld inner speech.
branch_activations.boundary: This is an attributed focus trace; the local spoken-saying meaning remains intact and the inner register is not treated as a new spoken utterance.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyi bilme, tanıma ve gerçeğine uygun biçimde kavrama durumu bilgisizliğin karşıtıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: The elative knowledge form carries knowing and grasping truth.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The emitted saying and the active concealment supply unequal access points for that knowing.
branch_activations.activation: Knowing meets a public statement and a withheld content clause, giving divine knowledge access independent of the speakers' emitted register.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Allah's knowing reaches the concealed register that human hearers receive only as unspoken content.
branch_activations.boundary: The registered core is knowing and grasping truth; no separate teaching or competitive knowledge use is claimed.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyin gerçekleşmesi, ortaya çıkması ve bulunur halde olması çekirdektir.
branch_activations.carrier: The auxiliary form carries occurrence and state continuity for the same plural group.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The ongoing concealment predicate and the earlier public saying give the hidden register duration beyond one utterance.
branch_activations.activation: State continuity meets concealment and the emitted claim, so the withheld register is heard as a temporally extended condition of the group.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The hidden register has a continuing history rather than existing only at the instant of the profession.
branch_activations.boundary: The registered core is the auxiliary being/state function; no independent location or submission facet is claimed.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel işlem, bir şeyin veya bilginin açıklanmasını engelleyerek onu gizli tutmaktır.
branch_activations.carrier: The concealment verb carries deliberate hiding from ordinary listeners.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The articulated saying supplies the public channel and the elative knowledge predicate supplies the unequal access that answers it.
branch_activations.activation: Deliberate hiding meets public speech and superior knowing, holding the second register away from ordinary listeners while leaving it known to Allah.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The ayah stages unequal access between emitted speech and the historically concealed register.
branch_activations.boundary: The registered core is withholding disclosure; no physical sealing or silence-only facet is asserted.
